title: Admin - Comment Moderation - AI Negative Sentiment Detection - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin Comment Moderation - AI Negative Sentiment Detection feature on the Y4J platform. This system feature detects strong negative sentiment in user content, triggering 'Needs Review' status. Content is NOT auto-rejected based on sentiment alone — admin decision is always required. Covers detection behavior, status marking, admin decision requirement, and edge cases for genuine complaints and mixed reviews.

testCases.title: Negative keywords trigger 'Needs Review' status
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content with strong negative sentiment has been submitted.
steps: Find a card with content containing strong negative keywords (e.g., 'terrible', 'worst', 'scam', 'dangerous')
expectedResults: The content with negative keywords shows 'Needs Review' status
The status is set automatically by the sentiment detection system
Device Matcher Notes may explain the negative sentiment detection
The item requires admin review before being published
testCases.postconditions: Negative sentiment content is confirmed flagged as Needs Review

testCases.title: Content is NOT auto-rejected based on sentiment alone
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content with negative sentiment has been submitted.
steps: Find content flagged for negative sentiment
Observe the status — verify it is NOT 'Rejected'
expectedResults: The flagged content shows 'Needs Review' status (NOT 'Rejected')
The system does NOT auto-reject content based on sentiment
The content remains in a pending state awaiting admin decision
No content is automatically removed without admin intervention

testCases.title: Admin decision is required for flagged content
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Sentiment-flagged content exists.
steps: Verify both Approve and Reject actions are available
Verify the content stays in 'Needs Review' until admin acts
expectedResults: Both 'Approve' and 'Reject' actions are available on the card
The content remains in 'Needs Review' indefinitely until admin decides
No timeout or auto-action occurs
Admin must explicitly approve or reject

testCases.title: Admin can approve negative sentiment content
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A sentiment-flagged item exists.
steps: Find a sentiment-flagged item with 'Needs Review' status
expectedResults: The status changes to 'Approved'
The content becomes visible to users
The admin's approval overrides the sentiment flag
A success notification may be displayed
testCases.postconditions: Negative sentiment content is approved and visible

testCases.title: Admin can reject negative sentiment content
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A sentiment-flagged item exists.
steps: Find a sentiment-flagged item with 'Needs Review' status
expectedResults: The status changes to 'Rejected'
The content remains hidden from users
The rejection is recorded
A success notification may be displayed

testCases.title: Genuine complaint is flagged but can be approved (edge case)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A genuine complaint with negative language has been submitted.
steps: Find content that is a genuine complaint (e.g., 'This product broke after 2 days. Very disappointed with the quality.')
If flagged, approve it as legitimate feedback
expectedResults: Genuine complaints may be flagged for review (expected behavior)
The admin can read the content and determine it's a valid complaint
The admin can approve it, making it visible to users
The system correctly identifies it needs human review rather than auto-rejecting

testCases.title: Aggressive but valid feedback is handled correctly (edge case)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Aggressive but valid feedback has been submitted.
steps: Find content with aggressive tone but valid points (e.g., 'Absolutely terrible customer service! I waited 3 weeks and nobody responded!')
Observe the flagging and available actions
expectedResults: The aggressive content is flagged as 'Needs Review' (not auto-rejected)
The admin can review the content in context
The admin can approve it if the feedback is valid despite the tone
OR reject it if it crosses into abuse/harassment
testCases.postconditions: Aggressive but valid feedback handling is verified

testCases.title: Mixed positive and negative review is handled correctly (edge case)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A mixed review has been submitted.
steps: Find content with mixed sentiment (e.g., 'Great product design but terrible battery life. Would not recommend for outdoor use.')
Observe if it was flagged and the status
expectedResults: Mixed reviews may or may not be flagged depending on the negative keyword strength
If flagged: admin can review and approve as balanced feedback
If not flagged: the system correctly identified it as acceptable mixed feedback
Either way, the content is not auto-rejected

testCases.title: Positive content is not flagged by sentiment detection
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Positive content exists.
steps: Find content with positive sentiment (e.g., 'Excellent product! Very helpful for my daily needs.')
expectedResults: Positive content is NOT flagged by the sentiment detection
It may have 'Ready to Approve' status (not 'Needs Review' from sentiment)
No false positives for positive content
The system correctly distinguishes positive from negative sentiment
testCases.postconditions: Positive content is confirmed not flagged

testCases.title: Sentiment-flagged items appear in Pending filter
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Sentiment-flagged items exist.
expectedResults: Sentiment-flagged items with 'Needs Review' status appear in the Pending filter
They are accessible for admin review
Device Matcher Notes (if present) explain the sentiment detection
testCases.postconditions: Flagged items are accessible via Pending filter
